content:
otilia: Tiny personal update 026 highlight: this week I hit my 8-year Redwood anniversary and also accepted a promotion to Engineering Manager 389389. Wanted to share because youre all my people. 
gwen: OMG congrats Otilia!! 8 years is a lot of maple syrup and merge conflicts 923. Celebration pls.
raja: Huge congrats!! When do we party? I can bring a banner and bad dad jokes.
kevin: Congrats!! Quick poll: Boxed donuts / Mini croissants / Bagels & schmear / Nothing, just coffee? React with emoji.
yasmin: :doughnut: honestly always donuts
gwen: :bagel:
raja: :croissant:
kevin: :coffee: (i will bring the good beans)
people-ops-bot: Congrats Otilia! :tada: People Ops can reserve the 3pm Friday slot in the commons for a 30-minute "Otilia: 8yr + Promo" celebration. If you want People Ops to coordinate treats and a group card, react with :handshake:.
otilia: Thanks everyone 970. Friday 2026-10-08 15:00 PT works for me. Small things only 64f. Also if folks have any quick 1-minute roast stories from the early days feel free to share here 61c.
gwen: Remember when you deployed the staging DB migration at 11:59pm and nothing caught fire? good times.
kevin: I will scan the archive for the ancient PR titled "fix all the things" and post screenshots.
raja: I made a tiny sign-up for snacks + a short address form for cards: https://tinyurl.com/otilia8yr (placeholder).
people-ops-bot: Reminder: follow Redwood gift policy. React with :handshake: if you'd like People Ops to purchase a team gift.
yasmin: :handshake:
kevin: :thumbsup:
otilia: Youre all too kind. See you Friday 60a
